evidence: Major changes across src/validation.cpp, src/node/chainstate.cpp, and src/node/blockstorage.cpp removing multi-chainstate infrastructure
rationale: Proposes removing multi-chainstate architecture to eliminate pervasive maintenance burdens across validation and storage. The author notes that 'ordinary validation changes have to account for different chainstate roles, candidate sets, notifications, downloads, pruning, cache allocation, database lifetimes and locks', addressing a major recurring architectural complexity in the most critical subsystem.
